notes: Launch: a windowed game that opens bigger than the screen is maximized (the game reopens at the size it saved maximized, title bar on top, so it ran under the taskbar); a window the player made smaller is left alone. Checked by the player on a real launch

Mod List: a not-installed mod taken out of the list (removed, or replaced by its new id) leaves the profile too, instead of coming back at the end; jumping to a mod outside the profile or hidden by a filter shows it (the panel fell back to the list's first mod). Reading the mod list only reconciles the Zomboid folder that holds the default.txt it read: with a temporary folder in the tests it fell through to the user's real one and rewrote its active profile with the test's mods
Mod List: a mod that is not installed shows one 'not installed' chip, the health check's (with its fix), not two

Mod Health: a mod whose author changed its id in an update is no longer 'unsubscribed or deleted'. Steam downloads on every screen: a bar shows what Steam is downloading for the game (the items, queued / preparing / downloading / installing, MB and speed) and says when it is done, reading the mods again so the Mod List has them. Read from Steam's own logs and the bytes its process has written since the job started (Steam logs no progress and preallocates the files); no Steam API, so the player is never shown as in-game. Checked on a real download: 9.9 MB written for a 9.8 MB job
